head: 260deffba9620bf19c0f5b46cf2f81ed91760009
environment: Ubuntu 24.04 virtual runner, BIRD 2.14, Keepalived 2.2.8, IPVS 1.31, one router, two director namespaces
scope: Both directors installed by install-routed.py, with real systemd Keepalived/IPVS and BIRD/BFD/sync units. The lab prepared networks, backend and health probe.
restart: Both routed units and the secondary base unit restarted; TCP/UDP checks passed afterwards.
update_and_rollback: An invalid config was rejected. A valid health-check change took both secondary backend weights from 1 to 0 and withdrew its VIP advertisement; restoring the config returned both weights to 1 and reenabled the route. A forced reload failure restored the prior file; TCP/UDP checks still passed.
limit: One short virtual run. No physical links, two-host reboot, sustained capacity, operator acceptance or production SLO qualification.
